name: std::scoped_allocator_adaptor<OuterAlloc,InnerAlloc...>:: select_on_container_copy_construction
intro: Creates a new instance of std::scoped_allocator_adaptor, where the outer allocator base class and each inner allocator subobject are obtained by calling std::allocator_traits<A>::select_on_container_copy_construction().

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: A new std::scoped_allocator_adaptor object, constructed from correctly copied allocators.

examples.title: Practical use case
examples.input: Run the self-contained program; assertions check the documented behavior.
